name: sistlabum
description: Portal Sekolah Satu Pintu (SISTLABUM) — monorepo: backend Laravel API + frontend Next.js terpadu.

scripts.dev: (trap 'kill 0' SIGINT EXIT; npm run api & npm run web & wait)
scripts.api:setup: cd apps/api && composer install && (test -f .env || cp .env.example .env) && php artisan key:generate && php artisan migrate --seed
scripts.setup: npm run api:setup && npm run web:setup
